verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's install docs list several documented paths: installer script, npm/pnpm/bun, Docker, and signed desktop installers. Its getting-started guide promises install, onboarding, and a first chat in about 5 minutes, and the Gateway serves a browser Control UI for chatting. A community comparison says a rival was harder to set up than OpenClaw, which is relative support for its ease of setup. Missing for 10: the actual one-line install command is not quoted in the evidence, and there is no independent hands-on confirmation of the minutes-to-first-chat timeline.
